form-data.justification: CRLF injection only affects explicit proxy usage which we do not use

axios.justification: Axios is a transitive dependency of @stellar/stellar-sdk and stellar-sdk. The DoS/prototype-pollution advisories require an attacker-controlled request body or config — axios is not used directly in request handlers. Will be resolved when stellar-sdk upgrades axios.

body-parser.justification: Low-severity DoS only triggers when an invalid limit string is passed. Our Express configuration uses only numeric byte limits (e.g. '1mb') which are validated at startup. Upgrading express@5 would resolve this; tracked under DEV-603.

morgan.justification: Log-forging via :remote-user token. We do not use the :remote-user token in our morgan format string. Mitigated by input sanitisation in requestLog middleware. Will upgrade to morgan@1.11.0 in the next dependency maintenance sprint.

@stellar/stellar-sdk.justification: Major version upgrade from 14.x to 16.x requires coordinated migration of Stellar transaction signing APIs. Tracked for Q4 2026 maintenance sprint.

dotenv.justification: dotenv 17.x drops Node 14/16 support and changes config API. Requires testing across environments. Scheduled for Q4 2026 maintenance sprint.

express.justification: Express 5.x has breaking changes in error handling and router API. Requires full regression testing. Scheduled for Q4 2026 major-dependency upgrade sprint.

has-flag.justification: has-flag 5.x is ESM-only. Our build currently uses CJS. Upgrading requires ESM migration. Scheduled for Q4 2026 maintenance sprint.

morgan.justification: Upgrading to morgan@1.11.0 to resolve log-forging CVE. Minor version bump, low risk. Included in next dependency patch window.

pg.justification: pg 8.22.0 is the latest in the 8.x line. npm outdated is comparing against a pre-release/unstable tag. Current version is up-to-date within the 8.x stable series.
